name: qkd_ctrl_pc_cdc_s7c-s7c-COMMIT
purpose: cdc_s7c (Q-KVELEM2 2026-10-17, rtl_change): CLOSED cdc_s7b (qkd_ctrl_pc_cdc_s7b-s7b-71d281424, main c39b4cded) native pin audit FAIL by one pin: TT launch 225.1 > 220 on idle_core (next er[81] 203.2; capture 152.9, R 162.0, 0 comb; /home/ubuntu/artifacts/qkvret-r5-1016/cdc_s7b_native_audit.json). Cause: idle_core = idle_core_r && !es0_idle_q, an AND after two flops, so the port was not flop-driven. Fix: ONE export flop idle_core <= idle_next && !es[0] (the AND of the two next states; both old flops were async-cleared by rs_q and loaded on the same ck edge), 0 cycles, bit-identical at every pin vs the cdc_s7b RTL (bench tb_cdc_idle_export_equiv, mutant OT_CDC_IDLE_EXPORT_MUT fails). Same outline, pins, kit recipe. | KVCTRL core_s7 (lead Q-KV decision 2026-10-17): core_s6w CLOSED TT +4.34 / FF +10.33 but native audit FAIL (R 265.4: one hclk root of 13.8k sinks over 116.6 x 216 um measured ~275 ps TT insertion; launch 420.6 on 216 pins, capture 401.5 on 175 pins incl. ~155 ps of hold-ECO IO padding). The core is split into three hardened children with short roots (target R <= 170), every pin flop-first: qkd_ctrl_pc_sched (u_ctl, tag queue, raw check, arbiter, W/E pin flops, KV drain / idle_hbm), qkd_ctrl_pc_cdc_child (u_ecdc both clocks + core-clock intake / intake check / er / core drain / idle_core / static completion crossing, with pin registers on the u_ctl credit and the embedding return and output registers on the down FIFO), qkd_ctrl_pc_obs_child (native write observer behind input pin registers + native commit pin registers). Priced vs core_s6: static embed command +1 hclk, embedding return +1 hclk, u_ctl credit +1 hclk, native commit observation +1 hclk; KV read/write traffic 0 edges. CDC: W = strip-engine intake face, N = er / completion / idle + clocks, S = sched seams, E = embedding return from the port child. s7b: cdc_s7 gate (108x108, util 35%) ck boundary mean 194.7 TT / max 203.5: compact 97.2 x 86.4 (~45%), es_context moved to the N face (pin density).
